page_note: Page is dominated by substrate cosmology: First Man's release from the all, Mother of Life's intercession, building of the cosmos with firmaments/wheels/ships of Light/mountains, the Five (Great One of Spirit, Beloved of Lights, Great Builder, Living Spirit, First Man) standing fast at consummation, and intercession with the Father. One clear editorial seam at seg 7 ('Behold, then, I have taught you...') with hortatory voice, followed by an application stretch (10-12) that maps the cosmic intercession pattern onto the death of 'the holy faithful one' (ⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ) — explicit cosmos→contemporary believer mapping. The cosmic restatement (13-15) returns to substrate. Heavy damage (61%) but teaching purity remains high.
